name: Should I hire a general contractor or a specialized demolition company for wall removal?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a general contractor or a specialized demolition company for wall removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: For interior wall removal, especially if it involves structural changes, utility rerouting, or subsequent finishing work, hiring a general contractor is generally recommended. A general contractor can manage the entire project from start to finish, including structural assessments, securing permits, coordinating sub-trades (like electricians and plumbers), and overseeing the finishing touches. A specialized demolition company might be suitable for demolition-only tasks but won't handle the complete project management or finishing work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a general contractor for interior wall removal, especially if it involves structural changes, utilities, or finishing work, as they manage the entire project.
